comparison: At each of the six saved cycle-5 actors and frozen cycle-6 models, sample one fixed batch of 256 actual cycle-6 collection states with exact causal history/EMA. Compute H32 no-tail actor parameter directions using full feedback backpropagation or detaching only history/features at the policy input edge. Require exactly equal forward objective and active-step count. Keep plant-state BPTT, direct parameter dependence and previous-action reward derivatives in both routes. Normalize each raw parameter direction to unit L2. On a second fixed 256-state calibration batch, adjust only coefficient magnitude to the prescribed latent-mean RMS tolerance (0.1 percent). Test both signs and both amplitudes on the same three representative origin-zero full-thirty-second references; reuse all eighteen existing cycle-5 baselines.
gradient_semantics: The stopped-input route is a surrogate/semi-gradient, not the true derivative of the unchanged forward scalar. Report its projection and the full objective gradient's projection separately, alongside actual model-return changes and physical outcomes. No claim that its own projection must match a finite difference of the full controller.
budget_and_selection: No Adam step, optimizer moment reconstruction, value/model refit, checkpoint selection, early stopping or physical outcome-based amplitude search. Calibration uses only fixed training inputs, never physical rewards. Include all six runs, both routes, signs, amplitudes and failed full-thirty-second trials. These three known reference cases do not constitute the full 27-cell policy gate or an unseen-motion test.
